text:
Ana: Quick scope huddle. Need to lock cuts to keep MVP date. Proposing minimal surface below.
Devon: list please.
Ana: Keep runtime + hosted API, minimal model pin by id (API + CLI), tiny console header showing pinned model. Defer full pin UI, tag filters, route-level long retention telemetry, embeddings dashboard, and eval automation to v1.
Kai: Agree. Full pin UI is larger frontend risk. Backend proto ready.
Raj: Pilots care about rollback speed. Can we add rollback endpoint + CLI?
Devon: Yes 18; add POST /pins/rollback and a small CLI wrapper. Saves ~2 FE sprint-weeks.
Marie: UX: include header with link to CLI docs so pilots aren't confused. I'll draft copy.
Ana: Keep canary core and a minimal toggle + % slider in console; advanced rollouts to v1.
Devon: Estimates: CLI+header+toggle = 10 dev-days, rollback endpoint = 4 dev-days, canary safety tests = 6 dev-days (total ~20).
Kai: I'll validate rollback <3m and canary latency add <500ms by tomorrow.
Raj: I'll notify pilots (@acme_pilot, @greenleaf_pilot) and surface objections.
release-bot: Reminder: milestone freeze in 9 business days; last build cutoff 1776505400.
Ana: Action items: Devon confirm estimates EOD; Kai confirm SLA tests; Marie write header & CLI doc; Raj notify pilots. I'll update milestone tracker and backlog v1 items.
Devon: Also: log rollback audit trail (request_id + actor). Low effort, high value.
Marie: header copy will state "pinned models are global to tenant."
Ana: Good. Locking scope by EOD tomorrow unless pilots push back.
